Diagnosis.submission: A NetworkPolicy named deny-all-recommendation in the hotel-reservation namespace is blocking all ingress and egress traffic to the recommendation service pods (labeled io.kompose.service=recommendation). The NetworkPolicy has policyTypes [Ingress, Egress] with no allow rules, which denies all traffic to the recommendation service. This prevents the frontend from reaching the recommendation service via gRPC, and prevents the recommendation service from accessing its MongoDB database (mongodb-recommendation) and service registry (Consul). The recommendation service registered in Consul before the policy was applied, so it appears healthy in Consul, but it is actually completely network-isolated and cannot serve any requests. The root cause is this overly restrictive NetworkPolicy that was applied after the service started.
